item_short_desc: Rothco’s Woodland Camo Shopping Bag combines style and durability for reliable carrying. Available in 2 sizes—small (9 inch x 5 inch x 14 inch) and medium (12 inch x 7 inch x 23 inch)—you can select the bag that best fits your shopping needs. The shopping bag features dual loop handles for a comfortable grip and easy transport. Made from 1.25 mil thick plastic, it offers increased durability and reusability, making it a practical choice for frequent use. Each bundle includes 100 bags.
